questions.stem_text:
The effects of iron on certain aspects of socio-emotional development (shyness,
orientation/engagement and response to unfamiliar pictures) is due to:

options.A: The role of iron in serotonin production
options.C: The role of iron in neurochemistry
options.D: The role of iron in maintaining blood sugar levels
options.E: The role of iron in muscle function

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The role of iron in serotonin production

questions.stem_text: Consanguinity shows a strong association with which pattern of inheritance?

Which products of ADP degradation increase in concentration in the blood during multiple
sprint sports?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Ammonia, urea and creatine.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following structures should be visible on a dental panoramic radiograph?

options.A: Only the mandibular canal and hard palate
options.B: The mandibular canal, maxillary sinus, hard palate, zygomatic arch, and ethmoid sinus
options.C: The mandibular canal, maxillary sinus, hard palate, zygomatic arch, and frontal sinus
options.D: The mandibular canal and maxillary sinus

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Only the mandibular canal and hard palate

questions.stem_text:
A patient suffers a broken neck with damage to the spinal cord at the level of the sixth
cervical vertebra.

options.A: It is impossible to predict an effect on breathing.
options.B: Their breathing rate will significantly increase.
options.C: They will only be able to breathe quietly.
options.D: Their breathing will be erratic and unpredictable.
options.E: They will be unable to breathe without life support.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - They will only be able to breathe quietly.
